fix_summary: Off-by-one in the retry gate. The code checks `attempt > MAX_ATTEMPTS` after making the call, which allows one extra call beyond the configured maximum. Change the condition to account for the just-completed attempt: `if attempt + 1 >= MAX_ATTEMPTS: return False` so the total number of calls does not exceed MAX_ATTEMPTS.
suggested_test: Create a test where an operation always returns {"ok": False, "status": 503}. Count invocations and assert call_with_retry makes exactly MAX_ATTEMPTS calls (default 5) and invokes on_giveup once. This will fail before the fix (6+ calls) and pass after.
